details.description: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is a 7-billion-parameter dense reasoning model that DeepSeek released in January 2025 alongside DeepSeek-R1, fine-tuning Alibaba's Qwen2.5-Math-7B on about 800,000 reasoning traces generated by DeepSeek-R1. DeepSeek's model card presents it as a mid-sized member of the R1 distillation family, transferring R1's chain-of-thought reasoning into a model smaller and cheaper to run than the full 671B R1. DeepSeek recommends running it without a system prompt at a temperature of 0.5-0.7, and notes it can sometimes skip its own reasoning step. Both the model weights and DeepSeek's code are released under the MIT License.
advantages: Supports a 131,072-token context window, inherited from its Qwen2.5-Math-7B base, per its Hugging Face configuration file.
Scores 92.8% pass@1 on MATH-500, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 55.5% pass@1 on AIME 2024, rising to 83.3% with 64-sample consensus voting, per DeepSeek's model card.
Scores 49.1% pass@1 on GPQA Diamond, per DeepSeek's model card.
DeepSeek reports a CodeForces rating of 1189 for this model, per its model card.
Released under the MIT License, permitting commercial use and further distillation, per DeepSeek's model card.
disadvantages: Scores 37.6% pass@1 on LiveCodeBench, below the larger 14B and 32B members of DeepSeek's R1-distill family, per DeepSeek's model card.
DeepSeek's model card says the distilled models can skip their own reasoning step on some queries, which may require forcing the response to start with '<think>\n'.
Text-only reasoning model; its model card documents no vision or tool-use support.
use_cases: Reasoning, math and coding tasks on mid-sized hardware.
General question answering with chain-of-thought reasoning.

notes: Catalog's max_input/output tokens (131072) match this model's max_position_embeddings in its Hugging Face config.json, so no discrepancy. No maker source marks this model deprecated or superseded; it remains a mid-sized checkpoint from DeepSeek's January 2025 R1-distillation release.
